citations.quote: 權益資產一直都處於牛市階段，我的持股組合每年的股東權益和派息都持續增長，怎麼可能不是呢？股價，就別提了
股票是一個平均贏的游戲，前提是必須盡可能壓縮交易費用，以及避免輸家的行業。

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: 狗不叫 tests the market regime against the business, not the tape: if his portfolio's per-share shareholder equity and dividends grow every year (~10% weighted, pre-ex-dividend, per his own reply), it is in a bull market regardless of price. Equities are an "average win" game over a long enough horizon, conditional on compressing trading costs and avoiding loser industries.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Business-value bull market: judge the regime by equity and dividend growth, not price
